item.title: Canada Approves Some Gulfstream Jets After Trump Threats
item.description: Canada’s aviation regulator issued certificates for some Gulfstream jet models after President Donald Trump complained the country had “refused” to greenlight the aircraft and threatened tariffs and other measures in retaliation.

item.title: Trump Signs 10% Global Tariff in Bid to Salvage Trade Agenda
item.description: President Donald Trump imposed a 10% global tariff on foreign goods, moving quickly to preserve his trade agenda after the US Supreme Court struck down many of the levies he imposed last year.

item.title: Mexico, Canada Get Exemption to 10% US Levy But USMCA Risk Looms
